gloss: stone material; building stone; masonry material

definitions.gloss: stone material; building stone; masonry material
definitions.explanation: Natural stone that has been quarried and processed for use in construction, decoration, or other applications.

examples.english: I laid stone in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{石材|せきざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{造|つく}られている→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This castle was built with local stone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大理石|だいりせき}→大理石：20505_dairiseki⟧や{花崗岩|かこうがん}⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、さまざまな{石材|せきざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カウンター→カウンター：10816_kauntaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Various stone materials such as marble and granite are used for kitchen counters.

notes:
Composed of {石|せき} (stone) + ⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (material). Used in construction, architecture, landscaping, and interior design contexts. Japan has a long tradition of stone masonry, particularly in castle walls (⟦{石垣|いしがき}→石垣：19673_ishigaki⟧) and garden design.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石材|せきざい}{店|てん} — stone dealer, stone yard
- {石材|せきざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加工|かこう}する→加工する：25223_kakousuru⟧ — process/work stone
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{石材|せきざい} — natural stone
- {石材|せきざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧ — types of stone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ — stone, rock; the everyday general word
- ⟦{岩石|がんせき}→岩石：20502_ganseki⟧ — rock; a geological/scientific term for rock as a natural material
- ⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧ — lumber, wood; the parallel term for wood as a building material
- ⟦{建材|けんざい}→建材：12646_kenzai⟧ — building material; a broader category that includes stone, wood, concrete, and other construction materials
